title: Lumi: 3.2M views, 477 trials
summary: Stacked pay with a fast review queue. Over 75 days Lumi funded 7 bounties on flowd. 37 creators posted 71 videos that earned 3.2M verified views, 6,793 tracked installs and 477 tracked trials, 182 of them converting to paid. Tracked means link and code only; estimated conversions are reported separately and never paid.
quote: We stopped counting views and started counting trials. Creators got paid on time and we found three hooks that carried the quarter.
